mechanism: Liraglutide delays gastric emptying and may reduce oral bisphosphonate absorption, while zoledronic acid (IV) carries risk of acute kidney injury which could impair liraglutide clearance in patients with renal compromise.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion, and assess glycemic control as GLP-1 agonists may affect fluid status; separate any oral medications by timing if applicable.
